name: Hallow
description:
Casting time: 1 day, or 1 hour if you are within your Sanctum.

You imbue an area with power. The area can have a radius up to medium range. When you complete the casting, choose one of the following effects:

  • Courage: Any number of creatures you choose can’t be forced to check Conditions or move while in the area.

  • Darkness/Light: Magical darkness or light, of a quality you choose, fills the area.

  • Repose: Dead bodies interred in the area can’t be turned into undead.

  • Unsettling: Any number of creatures you choose check one Condition when they enter the area and at the end of each minute they spend in the area.

  • Peace: All attack rolls made within the area are ill-favored, and all damage rolls take −1d.

  • Tongues: Creatures can communicate with any other creature in the area, even if they don’t share a common language.

  • Forbiddance: You ward the area against magical travel. Creatures and objects cannot enter the area via portals, teleportation or by moving into the area while Phased Out.

  • Nondetection: You ward the area against divination magic. No magical sensors can perceive anything within the area and creatures within the area cannot be targeted by spells that read or influence their minds or senses.

The effect lasts until you dispel it. Only creatures whose Challenge is greater than this spell’s XP cost, and spells with higher XP cost this this spell, can ignore, override or dispel the effect.

Describe your ritual and its effects.
